construct.name: evidence-qualified causal collaboration contribution
construct.intended_use: Verify lower/upper causal contribution bounds, resource-lineage and cross-agent causal edges, message-effectiveness separation, and duplicate action controls on hand-authored traces.
construct.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 synthetic graph-scoring reference only; no verified causal truth, human collaboration validity or agent capability claim.

units.observational_unit: action record and directed causal-edge record
units.independent_unit: One deterministic success trace plus one failure negative control
units.dependence_statement: Actions and causal edges form a single ordered dependency graph; causal ancestry is not treated as independent observations.

sources.missingness_semantics: The deterministic fixture has complete declared cells; absent cells are missing/unsupported, never zero.

evaluation_distribution.sampling_frame: One eight-action successful trace and one failed-task trace with six agent roles, verified/candidate causal edges, messages, resource transfer and repeated action fingerprint.

factors.weight_interpretation: Two authored controls; not a task success prevalence estimate.
Designed edge categories within the success trace; not a sampled causal-edge distribution.

perturbation_families.rationale: Shows how candidate causal edges widen the inclusive upper bound without entering the verified lower bound.
perturbation_families.validity_check: Recompute CCE lower/upper and cross-agent contribution metrics after changing evidence status; a model-proposed edge cannot be verified by assertion.
expected_invariants: Model-proposed causal edge never enters verified lower bound.
Candidate-inclusive upper bound is no smaller than verified lower bound.
Failed-task CCE remains zero even when partial checkpoint progress is present.
perturbation_families.seed_policy: Deterministic authored graph; no stochastic seed.

replication_design.independent_unit: One fixed deterministic design matrix; no stochastic or empirical replication is claimed.
replication_design.dependence_assessment: Scenario, strategy, participant and condition cells are deterministic benchmark fixtures, not independent draws from a target population.
replication_design.sample_size_rationale: One deterministic execution is sufficient to verify exact code paths and negative controls; it cannot support confidence intervals or population inference.

metrics.aggregation: success actions plus verified causal ancestors divided by all actions
success actions plus verified and candidate causal ancestors divided by all actions
verified and candidate-inclusive directed edge counts separately
verified and candidate-inclusive contributing message shares separately
instances beyond first within an identical action fingerprint group

baselines.description: Counts only independently qualified/verified causal edges.
Adds candidate causal edges as an explicit uncertainty envelope, never as truth.

negative_controls.intervention: Mark an edge with ModelProposed evidence kind as Verified.
negative_controls.expected_result: Validation rejects the trace; model assertion cannot self-certify causal truth.

negative_controls.intervention: Provide partial checkpoint progress but no final task success action.
negative_controls.expected_result: CCE lower and upper remain zero; partial success is retained as a separate progress metric.

negative_controls.intervention: Add communication actions without a verified causal path into success actions.
negative_controls.expected_result: Message count rises but verified message effectiveness remains zero.

holdouts.leakage_control: No empirical rows are used; this reference supports no external-generalization claim.

reproduction.runtime_environment: Rust edition 2024; deterministic benchmark crate; exact-head GitHub Actions workflow
reproduction.humanity_atlas_run_artifact_ref: Not applicable: synthetic benchmark reference execution; no full Humanity Atlas scenario artifact is claimed.

claim_report.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 synthetic graph-scoring reference only; no verified causal truth, human collaboration validity or agent capability claim.
known_limitations: Edges are supplied to the scorer; the kernel does not infer causality.
Evidence references are not authenticated by this fixture.
Temporal order is necessary for edges but is not sufficient to establish causal truth.
unsupported_strata: Human teams, live agent populations, real tool execution traces and source-verified causal mechanisms.

components.notes: Synthetic oracle or explicit deterministic controller; not a human or LLM.
Stable serial execution in declared input order.
Reject invalid or out-of-contract inputs; no silent repair.
Capture every declared input, step, output and metric; missing records fail closed.
No unseeded random source is used by this deterministic fixture.

scheduler_policy.update_order: stable declared fixture order; deterministic serial execution
scheduler_policy.tie_breaking_rule: stable identifier then stable input index

exposure_policy.eligibility_rule: not applicable to this deterministic reference fixture
exposure_policy.state_visibility: all declared synthetic inputs are visible to the benchmark runner
